scope: Lean v4.34.1 / Mathlib v4.34.1; statement fidelity per research/ecdlp_weakness_lean_20261104/README.md
statement: If the degree-<=1 part of the span of a finite set of rows has dimension below the number k of ideal elements with distinct linear leading monomials, no Groebner basis (degree-compatible order) of the ideal lies in that span: d_lin is a lower bound on the solving degree.
